feature: Recoverable experience archives and long-term review/release history

behavior.entry: 任务复盘 → 项目经验 → 归档经验；经验归档 → 查看来源复盘 / 恢复到经验库
behavior.archive: Archived experience snapshots preserve content, source references, timestamp and revisions in the existing project journal. The working library remains bounded at 100 entries; archives are separate and paged at 20 entries. A single durable commit updates working membership and the archive index.
behavior.matching: Archived IDs are excluded from future matching, including existing published versions and rollback. Restoration returns the previous working advice and enabled state; current release content and the project pause switch still determine applicability. Restoration does not publish drafts.
behavior.portability: Uses the existing non-evicting .aistudio/agent project journal and content-addressed artifacts. Restart and copied-project restoration preserve archives and original evidence; no deletion or automatic archival policy added.
behavior.reviews: All retained review events build a lightweight index; reports load on demand with a 100-report cache and 50-report pages. Old execution evidence is scanned in bounded windows instead of losing tasks outside the latest 50,000 events. Per-task analysis retains the existing 5,000-record and 8 MiB limits and reports incomplete coverage.
behavior.releaseHistory: The active optimization envelope stays bounded at 20 releases. Older committed releases are indexed from project history, paged separately, and remain available for report viewing and provenance-checked rollback. Historical validation evidence remains immutable.
behavior.validation: Strict project/revision/cursor checks, same existing mutation queue and busy guard. Corrupt archive/report content remains visible as an error without reviving stale advice. Delayed UI responses are discarded after disposal or project changes.

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and configured-value scan of generated files; no real credential store is read. A zero crash-dump count means no dump was generated.
